title: Hezekiah, Isaiah and the Assyrian Crisis
subtitle: 2 Kings 18-20, Isaiah 1-39, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah
theme: God’s holiness, judgment, and the great hope of a servant who will bear the sins of many.
memoryText: Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory.
reviewQuestions: What does Isaiah’s vision of God in chapter 6 teach about worship?
Who is the Servant in Isaiah 40-55, and what does he do?
How does Isaiah 53 describe substitutionary atonement?
What does “the just shall live by his faith” mean in Habakkuk’s context?
psalmsNote: Psalms 46, 48, 75, 76, 80, 81, and 83 beside Assyria’s threat. Psalms 22, 69, and 89 beside Isaiah’s servant.
